description: Check whether japanlaw.org holds a law, and find the name to pass as law. Every law japanlaw.org holds — or only those of one kind (法律 Act, 政令 Cabinet Order, 省令 Ministerial Order…), of one topic, or whose names hold query's words — each with its Japanese and English title, kind, law number and url; get_law has the rest. total counts the laws listed, held all the laws held, and kinds counts them by kind. A law not in the whole list is not held, whatever its kind — a 条例 (a prefecture's or city's ordinance) included — so say so rather than quoting its text from memory.

kind.description: Only laws of this kind: Constitution, Act (法律), CabinetOrder (政令), MinisterialOrdinance (省令), ImperialOrdinance (勅令), Rule (規則).

lang.description: The language of the pages every url opens, and of the card get_provision is drawn as: "en" (default) or "ja". The text returned always holds both languages.

query.description: Only laws whose title, short name, slug or law number holds these words, in Japanese or English (労基法, labor, 昭和二十二年法律第四十九号).

topic.description: Only the laws of one topic, as the site's laws pages group them: work, immigration, tax, social-security, business, consumers, civil, housing, crime, transport or government.

name: list_laws
title: List the laws held
